name: Sparkline
label: Sparkline
description: Inline trend line for stats and table cells, drawn without axes or chrome.

props.name: data
props.description: The series to plot, in order. Values are normalised into the viewBox.

props.name: variant
props.description: Rendering treatment — a bare line, or a line with a soft fill underneath.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Colour role for the line and end dot. `accent` follows the chart palette's
lead colour; `positive`/`error` map to the trend pair (up and down), named
like the status roles Gauge and the status components use; `neutral`
recedes to secondary text. `negative` is the legacy name for `error`.

props.name: showDot
props.description: Marks the final point with a small dot.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Line thickness in viewBox units — an SVG geometry attribute, not a token.

props.name: width
props.description:
ViewBox width. Also the default rendered width; the SVG scales to its
container when sized externally via CSS. Intentionally shadows the native
SVG `width` attribute, which it sets.

props.name: height
props.description:
ViewBox height. Also the default rendered height; the SVG scales to its
container when sized externally via CSS. Intentionally shadows the native
SVG `height` attribute, which it sets.

props.name: label
props.description:
Accessible description of the trend, e.g. "Revenue, trending up". When
omitted the SVG is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
